=== Case 5 ===
ISSUE:
BUG/TST robust norms bugs and unit tests
Robust `norms` do not have their own unit tests. They are only indirectly tested through RLM results.

old PR #1341 included some fixes for Hampel bugs and shifted tukey biweight.
see also #8697 and #8696 for Hampel bugs

Methods of norms used in RLM

- fit only uses `weights`
- cov_params, bcov_scaled uses `psi_deriv` and `psi`
- deviance uses `rho` (`__call__`)

unit tests possible against R robustbase
(in my old PR, I did not have reference numbers, I used mostly graphical inspection and checking formulas)
